inputs.text:
Well, look at the absolute panic from the conservative establishment as marginalized people and diverse households finally demand a shred of fairness in this deeply unequal economic system. We see Dublin South-West TD John Lahart and his party colleagues desperately trying to protect generational wealth hoarding, complaining about inheritance tax exemption thresholds and whining that the current system is supposedly ‘wholly unfair’ just because it might begin to recognize that human worth and social contribution aren't measured solely by whether or not someone had biological children. 

For generations, these tax structures have existed primarily to lock in dynastic wealth and compound historical inequalities, letting the privileged few pass down massive unearned windfalls while working-class families struggle under the weight of a rigged economy. Now, they have the audacity to frame basic economic equity as an attack on civilization itself, crying out for the preservation of privileges that only benefit traditional family models while leaving everyone else out in the cold. Mr. Lahart himself laid bare the reactionary anxiety driving this defense of the status quo when he stated, ‘At [...]’ revealing just how desperate they are to maintain institutional arrangements that entrench division and punish anyone who doesn't fit their narrow, rigid view of society. It is time to dismantle these systemic biases, reject the worship of inherited wealth, and build an inclusive society that supports all people, not just those anointed by traditional privilege.
